review_type: targeted primary-source and prior-art review; exploratory public mouse-data audit; not systematic
drug_decision: Dasatinib alone is the nominated approved medicine; phenotype-guided comparisons remain conditional. D+Q findings are indirect background, not single-agent efficacy.

studies.population_or_model: Other MVA patient-derived, SV40-transformed fibroblast lines; separate protein-replacement cell assays
studies.finding: Checkpoint function restored in the studied cell lines.
studies.limit: Not unmodified primary cells, a drug result or an assay of this exact pair. Abundance and intrinsic checkpoint/attachment function can differ.
studies.title: Molecular Causes for BUBR1 Dysfunction in the Human Cancer Predisposition Syndrome Mosaic Variegated Aneuploidy

studies.finding: Genetic clearance delayed selected muscle, fat and lens deficits; substantial survival extension and cardiac/vascular rescue were not established.
studies.limit: Not pharmacologic D+Q efficacy or pediatric MVA benefit.
studies.title: Clearance of p16Ink4a-positive senescent cells delays ageing-associated disorders

studies.population_or_model: BubR1 H/H hypomorphic mice for genetic SIRT2; separate young/aged wild-type mice for NMN
studies.intervention: Distinct experiments: genetic SIRT2 overexpression; short NMN exposure
studies.finding: Genetic SIRT2 overexpression extended mouse survival with a male-driven effect. Separate NMN work measured restoration of testicular BubR1 abundance in aged wild-type mice.
studies.limit: NMN did not establish MVA functional rescue or lifespan extension. Hypomorphic residual wild-type protein differs from an uncharacterized missense/null genotype.
studies.title: SIRT2 induces the checkpoint kinase BubR1 to increase lifespan

studies.population_or_model: Senescent human preadipocytes and endothelial cells; separate combination animal experiments
studies.intervention: Distinct dasatinib-only, quercetin-only and D+Q experiments
studies.finding: Dasatinib alone preferentially reduced senescent preadipocyte ATP-based viability; less activity in endothelial cells. Combination has separate evidence.
studies.limit: Single-drug Figure 2A is not a functional MVA assay. Combination apoptosis/animal findings cannot establish single-drug efficacy.
studies.title: The Achilles’ heel of senescent cells: from transcriptome to senolytic drugs
studies.exposure_interpretation: Nominal dasatinib concentrations overlap across senolytic and oligodendrocyte studies, but model/media/duration differ. No numerical therapeutic window follows; matched activity and neural-function exposure assessment is required.

studies.population_or_model: nine adults with diabetic kidney disease
studies.finding: Senescence-associated markers decreased after exposure.
studies.limit: Uncontrolled biomarkers do not establish MVA clinical efficacy.
studies.title: Senolytics decrease senescent cells in humans: Preliminary report from a clinical trial of Dasatinib plus Quercetin in individuals with diabetic kidney disease

studies.finding: Feasibility and exploratory functional outcomes reported.
studies.limit: No controlled pediatric MVA efficacy or dose.
studies.title: Senolytics in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: Results from a first-in-human, open-label, pilot study

studies.finding: 65 versus 22 nonserious adverse events; no statistically significant between-group exploratory functional difference detected.
studies.limit: Event counts are not participant counts; trial was underpowered for efficacy.
studies.title: Senolytics dasatinib and quercetin in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis: results of a phase I, single-blind, single-center, randomized, placebo-controlled pilot trial on feasibility and tolerability

studies.intervention: open-label randomized D+Q versus no-treatment control
studies.finding: Primary bone-resorption endpoint at 20 weeks did not differ between groups; P=0.611.
studies.limit: Exploratory subgroups do not establish overall efficacy or an MVA biomarker.
studies.title: Effects of intermittent senolytic therapy on bone metabolism in postmenopausal women: a phase 2 randomized controlled trial

studies.population_or_model: young-adult and aged mice; rat oligodendrocyte cultures
studies.finding: Myelin dysfunction despite no detected cell death; intermittent mouse exposure and component-specific process retraction in culture.
studies.limit: No human or MVA risk estimate; intermittent dosing or component removal is not an established safeguard.
studies.title: Senolytic treatment induces oligodendrocyte dysfunction and demyelination in the corpus callosum
studies.exposure_interpretation: Nominal dasatinib concentrations overlap across senolytic and oligodendrocyte studies, but model/media/duration differ. No numerical therapeutic window follows; matched activity and neural-function exposure assessment is required.

studies.finding: Specified oncology indications and safety warnings, including pediatric growth concerns.
studies.limit: Not approval of D+Q, senolysis or MVA treatment.
studies.title: SPRYCEL (dasatinib) prescribing information
Methods and combinations for killing senescent cells and for treating senescence-associated diseases and disorders
studies.finding: Reports adipose marker changes; p16 P=.07.
studies.limit: Patent evidence; sample size, randomization and functional rescue absent from Example 11.

studies.title: BubR1 allelic effects drive phenotypic heterogeneity in mosaic-variegated aneuploidy progeria syndrome
studies.finding: Tissue phenotypes and secretory signatures vary beyond total BUBR1/aneuploidy.
studies.limit: Different alleles from the child; experiments not randomized/blinded; see corrigendum 10.1172/JCI144781.

studies.title: The combination of senolytic drugs, dasatinib plus quercetin, reduces liver fibrosis in metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis: the TRUTH study
studies.finding: Primary histologic endpoint: 8/17 vs 1/14; P=.041. AEs:14/17 vs6/14; discontinuations3 vs1.
studies.limit: Congress abstract LBO-005-YI (Koning et al.); full trial paper not verified; not MVA efficacy or causal proof of senolysis.
studies.access_note: Official PDF pages S9–S10; text read and S9 visually inspected. DOI10.1016/S0168-8278(26)00309-0; NCT05506488.

studies.title: A pilot study of senolytics to improve cognition and mobility in older adults at risk for Alzheimer’s disease
studies.finding: Overall cognition and TNF-alpha changes were nonsignificant.
studies.limit: Exploratory subgroup findings and feasibility do not demonstrate efficacy.

studies.title: Senolytic therapy in mild Alzheimer’s disease: a phase 1 feasibility trial
studies.finding: Dasatinib detected in CSF in4/5; quercetin not detected.
studies.limit: Compartment-specific PK observation, not MVA neural efficacy/safety.

studies.title: Improved Oral Absorption of Quercetin from Quercetin Phytosome, a New Delivery System Based on Food Grade Lecithin
studies.finding: Quercetin absorption differed by formulation.
studies.limit: Manufacturer-affiliated study; no pediatric/senolytic efficacy inference.

studies.title: Metformin alters mitochondria-related metabolism and enhances human oligodendrocyte function
studies.finding: More myelin proteins/sheaths in studied systems.
studies.limit: Not MVA cells or clinical efficacy; no rationale for automatically combining with D+Q.

studies.title: Metformin hydrochloride tablets labeling
studies.finding: Type2 diabetes use and renal/lactic-acidosis precautions.
studies.limit: Not MVA approval or a safe fallback based on familiarity.

studies.title: Rejuvenating senescent and centenarian human cells by reprogramming through the pluripotent state
studies.finding: Age/senescence-associated features can be reset.
studies.limit: A disease model after reprogramming does not automatically preserve donor baseline cell state.

studies.title: An Essential Role for Senescent Cells in Optimal Wound Healing through Secretion of PDGF-AA
studies.finding: Transient senescent cells supported wound closure.
studies.limit: Not a D+Q or MVA experiment; distinguish reparative and persistent states.

studies.title: Profiling the molecular and physiological effects of senolytic treatment on aged mice identifies immune, fibrotic and metabolic remodeling
studies.finding: Tissue-dependent immune/metabolic remodeling with expression changes.
studies.limit: Cell-state changes alone do not establish selective clearance.
studies.access_note: Abstract and accessible extended data/supplement inspected; main text access limited; use publisher-updated files.

studies.title: The internal Cdc20 binding site in BubR1 facilitates both spindle assembly checkpoint signalling and silencing
studies.finding: BUBR1/BUB3/MAD2/CDC20 checkpoint-complex context.
studies.limit: Not an allele-specific drug-rescue experiment.

studies.title: BubR1 allelic effects drive phenotypic heterogeneity in mosaic-variegated aneuploidy progeria syndrome [biallelic]
studies.population_or_model: 23 mouse bulk RNA-seq samples; muscle/adipose; WT,H/H,H/L1002P
studies.finding: Exploratory reanalysis is documented separately in public_mouse_audit.
studies.limit: No drug-treated arms, patient material or neural tissue; metadata and bulk-composition limits.

studies.title: Proteostasis failure and mitochondrial dysfunction contribute to chromosomal instability-induced microcephaly
studies.intervention: Genetic mitochondrial chaperones/ROS handling; genetic autophagy changes; rapamycin
studies.finding: Genetic mitochondrial interventions restored brain size with partial neuroblast recovery. Rapamycin source Figure S6C: mean neuroblasts +20.6% but mean brain-lobe area -21.3% versus vehicle.
studies.limit: Not BUB1B exact-allele, human neural-function or clinical drug-rescue evidence. Full primary XML inspected; published March 12, version of record April 28. Recovered supplementary workbook and figure inspected 2026-09-11. No animal/batch identifiers; 12/18 neuroblast and 12/19 area measurements. Descriptive arithmetic only; not a human or BUB1B drug-rescue finding.

studies.title: ClinVar VCV000533901.9: BUB1B c.2210T>G, p.Leu737Ter
studies.finding: Aggregate pathogenic/likely pathogenic; multiple submitters without conflicts.
studies.limit: Predicted NMD/truncation is not measured residual function or treatment response. Current official VCV XML inspected.

studies.title: ClinVar VCV004600147.1: BUB1B c.3006T>A, p.Asn1002Lys
studies.population_or_model: Different DNA allele, same amino-acid substitution
studies.finding: Uncertain significance, single submitter.
studies.limit: This T>A allele is NOT the submitted T>G allele; its classification must not be transferred. Current official VCV XML inspected.

studies.title: ClinVar exact-DNA queries for BUB1B c.3006T>G
studies.finding: No matching record found in the tested exact-DNA queries.
studies.limit: Not an exhaustive proof of database absence or a benign/pathogenic classification. Search replies saved locally.

studies.title: ClinicalTrials.gov MVA and BUB1B targeted search
studies.finding: No relevant trial identified by reviewed terms. Parent repeated full-disease query with zero results; independent reviewer checked the other terms.
studies.limit: Not proof no relevant research or broad eligibility study exists; standalone MVA creates unrelated hits.

studies.title: Prenatal diagnosis and long-term follow-up of a Chinese patient with mosaic variegated aneuploidy and its molecular analysis
studies.finding: Survival into adulthood and management of renal disease and tumors reported.
studies.limit: No comparator to infer treatment-attributable survival or systemic cure; full primary XML inspected.

studies.title: Update on Recommendations for Cancer Screening and Surveillance in Children with Genomic Instability Disorders
studies.finding: Provides complication-focused cancer surveillance recommendations.
studies.limit: Consensus is not proof of MVA disease correction or individualized survival benefit. Independent reviewer inspected primary guidance.

studies.title: FDA Drug Trials Snapshot: Forzinity
studies.finding: Accelerated approval based on muscle-strength changes in open-label extension; randomized walking/fatigue endpoints missed.
studies.limit: Different initiating defect and mitochondrial target; approval does not establish MVA response. Official snapshot inspected.

studies.title: MMPOWER-3: elamipretide in primary mitochondrial myopathy
studies.finding: Walking distance and fatigue endpoints not improved at 24 weeks.
studies.limit: Different disease; demonstrates that mitochondrial dysfunction alone does not predict response. Primary trial reviewed by separate research agent.

studies.title: FDA Drug Trials Snapshot: Skyclarys
studies.finding: Randomized neurological endpoint evidence supported approval; primary analysis 82 of 103 randomized participants.
studies.limit: Frataxin-related disease; no BUB1B restoration or aneuploid neural-cell therapeutic window established. Official snapshot inspected.

studies.title: 4-Phenylbutyrate ameliorates apoptotic neural cell death in Down syndrome by reducing protein aggregates
studies.population_or_model: NGN2-induced neurons from two trisomy-21 donors (three clones) and one trisomy-13 donor (two clones), with two diploid control lines/clones. Additional corrected-disomy comparisons support baseline trisomy-associated pathology; they are not a separate demonstration of drug benefit.
studies.intervention: sodium 4-phenylbutyrate during induction, days 0-14; main drug-treatment Methods specifies 100 micromolar culture exposure
studies.finding: Reduced aggregate, ER-stress and cleaved-caspase-3 readouts.
studies.limit: Prevention during induction; no demonstrated mature-neuron functional rescue, electrophysiological benefit, ongoing BUB1B chromosome-error correction or patient benefit. Multiple clones are not independent donors. One trisomy-13 clone also carried a chromosome-3 inversion.

studies.title: Elimination of protein aggregates prevents premature senescence in human trisomy 21 fibroblasts
studies.population_or_model: Primary fibroblasts from four trisomy-21, three trisomy-18 and one trisomy-13 donor, with three healthy controls; separate secondary-fibroblast experiment from one trisomy-21 iPSC clone and its corrected-disomy derivative
studies.intervention: sodium 4-phenylbutyrate; secondary-fibroblast senescence experiment used 2 mM for two weeks beginning at passage 6 before overt senescence
studies.finding: Reduced aggregates in primary trisomic fibroblasts; reduced subsequent SA-beta-gal positivity in secondary trisomy-21 fibroblasts.
studies.limit: Not reversal of established neural dysfunction or proof of benefit in continuing BUB1B-related chromosome instability.

studies.title: PHEBURANE sodium phenylbutyrate prescribing information, revised July 2026
studies.population_or_model: Approved adult and pediatric urea-cycle-disorder use; adult pharmacokinetic and juvenile-animal safety evidence
studies.finding: Current approved indication and product pharmacology; neurotoxicity warning for phenylacetate.
studies.limit: No MVA approval or therapeutic window. Parent/metabolite exposures differ; adult plasma exposure cannot establish developing-brain safety.

studies.title: Dasatinib reverses Cancer-associated Fibroblasts (CAFs) from primary Lung Carcinomas to a Phenotype comparable to that of normal Fibroblasts
studies.finding: Reduced cell-cycle transcripts including BUB1B; reversible growth arrest after washout without increased cell death under tested conditions.
studies.limit: Not a functional spindle-checkpoint assay, MVA injury or senolytic-efficacy demonstration. Report cites the published experiment; follow-up reanalysis is outside the scoped submission.

studies.title: Senolytics, dasatanib plus quercetin, reduce kidney inflammation, senescent cell abundance, and injury while restoring geroprotective factors in murine diabetic kidney disease
studies.population_or_model: STZ diabetic male C57BL/6J mice; cell experiments in other models
studies.intervention: D+Q versus vehicle; no single-drug animal arms
studies.finding: Lower plasma creatinine and glomerular injury; unchanged glucose.
studies.limit: No measured GFR claim, MVA response, isolated dasatinib benefit or causal-clearance proof; source timing descriptions differ.

studies.title: Dasatinib and quercetin senolytic treatment delays early onset intervertebral disc degeneration in SM/J mice
studies.population_or_model: SM/J mouse disc degeneration; separate human NP cell experiments
studies.intervention: D+Q or navitoclax with respective controls
studies.finding: DQ improved disc morphology and cell retention; systemic navitoclax did not. Authors propose cell preservation as an alternative mechanism.
studies.limit: No dasatinib-only arm or MVA rescue. Morphology/markers do not establish pain or biomechanical recovery. Different cohorts and endpoint sample sizes require care.

studies.title: Assessing the Effects of Dasatinib on Mesenchymal Stem/Stromal Cells
studies.population_or_model: Commercial human bone-marrow MSCs, early and late serial passages; two named donors in osteogenic/adipogenic assays and two assessed in IDO assays; technical triplicates
studies.intervention: Dasatinib alone versus vehicle in non-MVA cell cultures
studies.finding: Reduced senescence-positive fraction with mixed post-treatment differentiation results; mineralization/DNA decreased in one donor; cartilage differentiation inconclusive.
studies.limit: No MVA model or organismal rescue. Live-cell counts per field do not establish selective death. IDO nonsignificance is not equivalence or immune-function preservation. Technical replicates do not increase independent donor count.
studies.reading_depth: Full public XML methods/results/discussion and figure captions; no raw-data reanalysis
studies.publication_date_note: Published October 2024; later PMC indexing must not be called a 2025 study.

studies.title: Effect of AZD1152 on BubR1 Hypomorphism
studies.finding: Reported survival improvement; no broader phenotypic recovery.
studies.limit: Conference abstract only; not dasatinib; market approval unverified.
studies.source_location: ASCPT 2013, LBII-2, printed p.92 / PDF p.94
studies.reading_depth: Full abstract extracted and page visually inspected; no raw-data reanalysis

studies.title: BubR1 Insufficiency Drives Transcriptomic Alterations and Pathology Associated With Cardiac Aging and Heart Failure
studies.population_or_model: 16-week mouse hypomorphic versus wild-type hearts; 12 deposited samples, three per genotype-sex group
studies.finding: Fixed-panel audit: seven positive author estimates; Cdkn2a/Cdkn1a/Igfbp2 reported adjusted P below .05.
studies.limit: Published summary-statistic audit, not independent DE fitting or sex adjustment. Different ages and tissue pipelines; no treatment validation.

patient_benefit_followup: Expanded exact-allele, human-outcome and restoration/preservation review on 8 September; no clinical benefit demonstrated and no supported lead change.
